content.title: J.T. Miller | 2026 U.S. Olympic Men's Hockey Team
content.text: Highlights Won gold with the U.S. Olympic Men's Hockey Team at the 2026 Olympic Winter Games Selected 11th overall in by the New York Rangers in the 2011 NHL Entry Draft Named to his first NHL All-Star Game in 2023-24 Has represented Team USA at the 2013 (gold) and 2012 IIHF World Junior Championships and the 2011 IIHF Under-18 World Championship (gold) International Career 2026 Olympic Winter Games - Milan, Italy (Gold Medal) Helped Team USA to its first Olympic gold medal in men's hockey since 1980 Played six games 2025 4 Nations Face-Off - Montreal, Quebec & Boston, Mass. (2nd Place) Played four games 2016 World Cup of Hockey (Team North America) - Toronto, Canada (5th Place) 2013 IIHF World Junior Championship - Ufa, Russia (Gold Medal) Led Team USA in assists (7) and tied for the team lead in points (9) 2012 IIHF World Junior Championship - Calgary & Edmonton, Canada (7th Place) Recorded four points (2g, 2a) in six games 2011 IIHF Under-18 World Championship - Crimmitschau & Dresden, Germany (Gold Medal) Led Team USA with 12 points (4g, 8a) in six games Professional Career 2025-26 | New York Rangers (NHL) Has played 48 games through Feb. 5, recording 36 points (14g, 22a) Captain 2024-25 | Vancouver Canucks (NHL) & New York Rangers (NHL) Played 40 games with Vancouver prior to a trade to the New York Rangers on Jan. 31, 2025 Recorded nine goals and 26 assists with the Canucks Played 32 games with the Rangers, recording 35 points (13g, 22a) 2023-24 | Vancouver Canucks (NHL) Led team with 103 points (37g, 66a) Set career high in goals and points Finished ninth in NHL in total points Played 13 playoff games registering 12 points (3g, 9a) Alternate captain 2022-23 | Vancouver Canucks (NHL) Finished season with 82 points (32g, 50a) in 81 games
